meta.name: stripe-best-practices
meta.description: Guides Stripe integration decisions — API selection (Checkout Sessions vs PaymentIntents), Connect platform setup (Accounts v2, controller properties), billing/subscriptions, Treasury financial accounts, integration surfaces (Checkout, Payment Element), migrating from deprecated Stripe APIs, and security best practices (API key management, restricted keys, webhooks, OAuth). Use when building, modifying, or reviewing any Stripe integration — including accepting payments, building marketplaces, integrating Stripe, processing payments, setting up subscriptions, creating connected accounts, or implementing secure key handling.

copy.tagline: 帮你做出正确的 Stripe 集成决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在集成 Stripe 支付或需要审查现有集成方案。
